packageRules.description: Open the weekly lock file refresh before majors, so a backlog of majors under the 3-PR cap never starves it
The dupes-isolated CI service container must match production (supabase/postgres 15.8.x -> postgres:15.8); never auto-bump it
Runtime-critical packages: one PR each, kept out of the weekly all-non-major group
Stay on the Node 24 LTS line: no Node 25+ (and no @types/node past 24). Production runs Node 24 from /opt/node-24 (docs/RUNBOOK.md); moving to another line is a deliberate decision, not a bot PR
react and react-dom must move together, in their own PR
